question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**some**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Some**" means a **minimum amount of**. 

 
 
• **Example:** *I had **some** beans for dinner. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "some".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Little** - small.

 
 
• **Example:** *The **little** girl looks pretty in her frock. *
 
 
 
• **Every** - all
 
 
• **Example:** ***Every** student was asked to follow the rules. *
 
 
 
• **Any** - an unspecified person or object.
 
 
• **Example:** *Do you have **any** colour pens? *
